items: turntable with built-in switchable phono preamp
why: Both chats answered with four single turntables (AT-LP70X, Fluance RT81/RT81+, AT-LP70XBT, Sony PS-LX3BT, AT-LP120XUSB) and said each 'can connect directly to powered speakers without a separate phono preamp'; the only add-on mentioned is an amplifier, and only if the shopper's speakers are passive. The shopper asked for the preamp built in so they would not need a second box. The fact that matters is setting the switch to LINE versus PHONO for the speakers they already own, so the page should compare models and recommend one turntable.
